nodes.description: uint256 public constant maxSupply = 100, hard cap on total token supply
uint256 private _price = 0.1 ether, price per token
uint256 private _reserved = 0, number of tokens reserved for team
string public HAR_PROVENANCE, provenance hash of the collection
uint256 public startingIndex, pseudo-random reveal index
bool private _saleStarted, gate controlling whether minting is open
string public baseURI used to build token metadata URIs
address Ines, payout recipient of 75% of contract balance
address InesM, payout recipient of 15% of contract balance
address Harems, payout recipient of 10% of contract balance
mint(uint256 _nbTokens) external payable whenSaleStarted, mints up to 20 tokens per call to msg.sender
flipSaleStarted() external onlyOwner, toggles _saleStarted and sets starting index on first activation
setStartingIndex() public, derives startingIndex from block.timestamp/difficulty/blockhash
withdraw() public onlyOwner, splits the contract balance 75/15/10 to three hardcoded addresses
claimReserved(uint256 _number, address _receiver) external onlyOwner, mints reserved tokens and decrements _reserved
setBaseURI(string _URI) external onlyOwner, sets baseURI
setPrice(uint256 _newPrice) external onlyOwner, updates _price
setProvenanceHash(string provenanceHash) public onlyOwner, stores provenance hash
walletOfOwner(address _owner) public view, enumerates all token ids of an owner
saleStarted() public view, returns _saleStarted
getPrice() public view, returns _price
getReservedLeft() public view, returns _reserved
_baseURI() internal view override, returns baseURI
_beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal override, forwards to ERC721Enumerable hook
supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public view override
constructor() ERC721('Shroomies, by Ines Helene','Shroomies'), disables sale at deployment
msg.sender, caller-controlled address used as mint recipient
block.timestamp, miner-influenced value used for pseudo-randomness
_safeMint -> _checkOnERC721Received -> IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received external callback
payable(Ines/InesM/Harems).send(...) external value transfers inside withdraw
weak pseudo-randomness: starting index derived from block.difficulty, block.timestamp and blockhash
mint parameter _nbTokens, number of tokens the caller wants to mint
setBaseURI parameter _URI
setPrice parameter _newPrice
setProvenanceHash parameter provenanceHash
walletOfOwner parameter _owner
claimReserved parameter _number, amount of reserved tokens to mint
claimReserved parameter _receiver, recipient of reserved tokens
_beforeTokenTransfer parameter from
_beforeTokenTransfer parameter to
_beforeTokenTransfer parameter tokenId
supportsInterface parameter interfaceId
constructor parameter name_
constructor parameter symbol_
mint local supply = totalSupply() before the mint loop
mint loop counter i
setStartingIndex local _block_shift derived from block values
setStartingIndex local _block_ref = block.number - _block_shift
withdraw local _balance = address(this).balance
withdraw local _split = 75% of balance
withdraw local _split2 = 15% of balance
withdraw local _split3 = 10% of balance
claimReserved local _tokenId = totalSupply()
walletOfOwner local tokenCount = balanceOf(_owner)
walletOfOwner local tokensId array of owned token ids

edges.reason: mint calls _safeMint, which performs an external call to the recipient contract via onERC721Received
malicious recipient can re-enter mint through the onERC721Received callback before supply accounting settles
msg.sender is the unrestricted caller and mint recipient of the payable mint function
msg.sender is passed as the recipient address into the _safeMint external callback
block.timestamp is consumed by the pseudo-random index computation (timestamp dependency)
block.timestamp feeds the unpredictable index derivation operation
miner-influenced random value is written into the public startingIndex state variable
setStartingIndex is public and unguarded, allowing any caller to trigger the index write once
maxSupply is used as the modulus when deriving startingIndex
flipSaleStarted calls setStartingIndex on the first activation of the sale
onlyOwner function toggles the _saleStarted flag
the whenSaleStarted modifier reads _saleStarted to gate mint
withdraw performs external value transfers via payable(...).send(...) to three recipients
withdraw sends 75% of the balance to the Ines address
withdraw sends 15% of the balance to the InesM address
withdraw sends 10% of the balance to the Harems address
setPrice (onlyOwner) updates the _price state variable
getPrice reads _price
setBaseURI (onlyOwner) writes the baseURI state variable
_baseURI override reads the baseURI state variable
setProvenanceHash (onlyOwner) stores the provenance hash
claimReserved decrements _reserved by _number (unchecked subtraction pattern under SafeMath import)
claimReserved mints reserved tokens through _safeMint external callback
recipient contract can re-enter claimReserved before _reserved is decremented
mint compares supply + _nbTokens against maxSupply - _reserved
mint reads _reserved in the supply limit computation
mint multiplies _nbTokens * _price and compares with msg.value
constructor initializes _saleStarted to false
caller-supplied _nbTokens drives the price multiplication and supply check in mint
_URI is assigned into baseURI
_newPrice is assigned into _price
provenanceHash is assigned into HAR_PROVENANCE
_owner is read by walletOfOwner to enumerate balances
_number bounds the mint loop and the _reserved subtraction
_receiver is the target address passed to the _safeMint external callback
from is forwarded to the ERC721Enumerable before-transfer hook
to is forwarded to the ERC721Enumerable before-transfer hook
tokenId is forwarded to the ERC721Enumerable before-transfer hook
interfaceId is compared in supportsInterface
name_ initializes the ERC721 token name
symbol_ initializes the ERC721 token symbol
mint caches totalSupply() into the local supply variable
mint declares the loop counter i used in the mint loop
setStartingIndex computes the local _block_shift from block values
setStartingIndex computes the local _block_ref used in blockhash
withdraw reads address(this).balance into the local _balance
withdraw computes the 75% share into the local _split
withdraw computes the 15% share into the local _split2
withdraw computes the 10% share into the local _split3
claimReserved caches totalSupply() into the local _tokenId
walletOfOwner stores balanceOf(_owner) in the local tokenCount
walletOfOwner allocates the local tokensId array of owned token ids

normalization_plan.reason: mint argument _nbTokens is only meaningful inside mint and should be folded into the mint function node
setBaseURI argument _URI is consumed only by setBaseURI
setPrice argument _newPrice is consumed only by setPrice
provenanceHash argument is consumed only by setProvenanceHash
walletOfOwner argument _owner is consumed only by walletOfOwner
claimReserved argument _number is consumed only by claimReserved
claimReserved argument _receiver flows into the _safeMint external call triggered by claimReserved
hook argument from is consumed only by _beforeTokenTransfer
hook argument to is consumed only by _beforeTokenTransfer
hook argument tokenId is consumed only by _beforeTokenTransfer
interfaceId argument is consumed only by supportsInterface
constructor argument name_ is consumed only during construction
constructor argument symbol_ is consumed only during construction
local supply is a temporary cache inside mint
loop counter i exists only inside the mint loop
_block_shift is a temporary inside setStartingIndex
_block_ref is a temporary inside setStartingIndex
_balance is a temporary snapshot inside withdraw
_split is a temporary split amount inside withdraw
_split2 is a temporary split amount inside withdraw
_split3 is a temporary split amount inside withdraw
_tokenId is a temporary supply snapshot inside claimReserved
tokenCount is a temporary balance cache inside walletOfOwner
tokensId is the return array built inside walletOfOwner
